decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9776. Series context: trend strength 0.9108 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.002); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.241.
